svg.aria-label: Atharva Lakhe. I build software that shows its work. Six projects: Security4Her, PSR-Net, SPARC, CarbonLedger, FancePro and LancePro.

g.text: I build software that shows its work.
Android and Wear OS. Satellite imagery. AI agents.

text.tspan: A women's safety system for Android and Wear OS.
One press, three knocks or three spoken words,
and her people know where she is.
